coordinate_system: Calibrated camera1 common-world XYZ, metres; no floor alignment

display.description: Display only: X right, -Y up, Z depth. Stored XYZ is unchanged.

graph_settings.endpoint_source: Original same-frame DINO reconstruction point_indices in unchanged frame_points order
graph_settings.retain_previous_edges: Only the same unordered pair of actual anonymous track IDs from the immediately previous reference frame, with both endpoints present and distance within the construction gate
graph_settings.pair_history_reset: Reset whenever either endpoint is absent or reference frames are not consecutive
graph_settings.forest_selection: Retain eligible previous edges first; then add lowest-cost candidates only when they join different components

interpretation.points: Actual calibrated DINO marker observations. Track identifiers are anonymous.
interpretation.edges: Visual connections between observed markers in the same frame, selected by distance and consecutive-track continuity. Not validated anatomical bones.
interpretation.missing: Missing markers and broken track continuity are not bridged. No inserted coordinates or gap interpolation.
